full_prompt_en: This is a square, monochrome concept illustration of a front-facing frontier figure in a wide hat and heavily layered mechanical gear against a plain warm cream ground. The person stands centered from the thighs upward, staring directly ahead with a severe, nearly expressionless face. A broad brim shadows the eyes, while gears and metal fittings sit on top of the hat crown. A thick scarf wraps several times around the neck and drapes down the chest. The long dark coat is loaded with straps, cartridge-like bands, pouches, buckles, and worn panels, giving the torso a compact mechanical weight. Two long barrel-like tools rise behind the right shoulder. Both gloved hands hang near the hips, where additional hardware and a belt interrupt the straight fall of the coat. A clear white capital letter W appears on the left chest of the dark garment. The background contains no landscape or architecture, allowing the layered costume to carry all the detail. Soft even light from the upper front reveals the folds of the scarf, scuffs on leatherlike surfaces, and the relief of small metal pieces; narrow shadows settle under the hat, around straps, and between pockets. The drawing combines clean silhouette control with dense pencil-like hatching and gray wash inside the garments. Pale negative space around the figure gives the long vertical outline room to read despite its many attachments. The overall composition is stark and utilitarian, using a disciplined grayscale palette and tactile gear to turn one standing pose into a detailed character study.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形单色概念插画，一名正面朝向观者的边疆人物戴宽帽、穿层叠厚重机械装备，立在素净暖奶油底面前。人物从大腿以上居中入画，以严厉、几乎没有表情的脸直视前方。宽帽檐遮住双眼，齿轮与金属配件坐在帽顶。厚围巾绕颈几圈，并垂到胸前。深色长外套装满绑带、弹带般的条纹、口袋、搭扣与磨旧饰板，使躯干具有紧凑的机械重量。两根长枪管状工具从右肩后方升起。戴手套的双手垂在髋旁，那里有更多硬件和腰带打断外套笔直下落的线条。深色衣物左胸可见清楚的白色大写字母“W”。背景没有风景或建筑，层叠服装因此承担全部细节。从上方前侧来的柔和均匀光显出围巾褶皱、皮革般表面的磨损和小金属件的浮起纹理；窄影落在帽下、绑带周围与袋口之间。画面在服装内部把清楚剪影控制与密集铅笔般排线、灰色渲染结合。人物四周的浅色负空间让有许多附件的绵长竖向轮廓仍可辨认。整体构图冷峻而实用，以有纪律的灰阶配色和有触感的装备把一个站姿转化为精细人物研究。
style_prompt_en: The concept-art treatment uses a warm pale ground against a near-monochrome range of graphite, charcoal, steel gray, and small ivory accents. Dense practical-looking details accumulate inside one clear, upright silhouette. Fine hatching and gray wash vary the texture of matte fabriclike areas, worn leatherlike surfaces, and hard metal edges. Even upper-front light reveals raised parts, while narrow dark gaps between layered pieces provide most of the depth. Outer contours remain firm; interior marks are numerous but subordinate to the whole shape. Generous blank margins prevent the intricacy from becoming crowded. The overall effect is gritty, functional, and carefully drawn, with surface wear and structural layering more important than dramatic scenery.
style_prompt_zh: 这种概念画处理让暖浅底面与石墨、炭黑、钢灰和少许象牙白强调组成的近单色色域相对。密集而似乎实用的细节累积在一道清楚直立剪影内部。细排线和灰色渲染变化出哑光织物般区域、磨旧皮革般表面与坚硬金属边缘的肌理。均匀的前上方光揭示凸起部件，层叠零件之间的狭窄暗缝提供大部分纵深。外轮廓坚定；内部标记虽多，却服从整体形状。宽阔空白边防止精细度变得拥挤。整体效果粗砺、实用且绘制仔细，表面磨损和结构层叠比戏剧性风景更重要。
theme_en: A frontier figure in a wide hat and layered mechanical gear
theme_zh: 一名边疆人物戴宽帽、身穿层叠机械装备
name: Westernpunk
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
